events.verdict: Fox (SAC) reaches in and puts a hand to Lillard's (POR) front which affects his FOM. The contact occurs prior to the upward shooting motion on the jump shot attempt.
Cauley-Stein (SAC) initiates marginal contact with Nurkic (POR) during the rebound.
Lillard (POR) places a hand on Fox's (SAC) body during his driving shot attempt, but the contact is marginal.
Nurkic (POR) is in the path of Fox (SAC) and doesn't deliver contact during the pick.
Fox (SAC) brings one hand to the opposite side of Nurkic's (POR) body and affects his SQBR.
Harkless (POR) engages with Bogdanovic (SAC) and affects his FOM.
Harkless (POR) reaches in and puts a hand/forearm to Bogdanovic's (SAC) front at the start of his drive which affects his SQBR.
Cauley-Stein (SAC) is in the path of Harkless (POR) and doesn't deliver contact during the pick.
Aminu (POR) makes contact with the ball and dislodges it from Fox (SAC) prior to the ensuing contact to his leg.
Nurkic (POR) cleanly blocks Cauley-Stein's (SAC) shot.
Hield (SAC) makes contact with Lillard's (POR) body but does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Nurkic (POR) is in the paint and actively guarding an opponent within three seconds.
Nurkic (POR) absorbs the oncoming contact and cleanly blocks Cauley-Stein's (SAC) shot.
Harkless (POR) brings his hand to Bjelica's (SAC) opposite hip and immediately removes it as he cuts to the basket.
Harkless (POR) cleanly blocks Bjelica's (SAC) shot attempt near the rim.
Nurkic (POR) is in the path Fox (SAC) and doesn't deliver contact during the pick.
Bogdanovic (SAC) initiates contact with Harkless (POR) during the drive but doesn't affect his ability to defend.
McCollum (POR) cleanly dislodges the ball from Hield (SAC).
Nurkic (POR) and Cauley-Stein (SAC) engage in incidental foot to foot contact.
Nurkic (POR) and Hield (SAC) engage and disengage without affecting each others ability to retrieve the loose ball.
Hield (SAC) makes contact with McCollum's (POR) body during the follow-through on his shot near the rim but does not affect his ability to follow-through naturally.
Harkless (POR) makes contact with the ball after it rolls completely out of the cylinder.
Hield (SAC) makes contact with Harkless' (POR) body but does not affect his put back shot attempt near the rim.
Hield (SAC) makes contact with Lillard's (POR) face/head after he gathers the rebound.
{Observable in Enhanced Video} Cauley-Stein (SAC) is in the paint for longer than 3 seconds without actively guarding an opponent.
Harkless (POR) impedes Cauley-Stein (SAC) during the rebound.
Hield (SAC) intentionally fouls McCollum (POR).
Harkless (POR) maintains a legal guarding position on Hield's (SAC) driving shot attempt.
Bjelica (SAC) intentionally fouls Nurkic (POR).
